C-PORTAL-PROSE.IntentSummary: Execute the user's requested run, review and selective adoption at the existing portal source owners; keep charter content fixed and verify the resulting bilingual projection.

T-001.Title: Complete the humanize run over eligible English page sources and shared copy

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: All selected sources have an output and report or a documented reason for exclusion or retained wording; original sources remain unchanged during generation.

Verification.Evidence: Run 20261004151241 coverage, source snapshots, worker results and closing gate.

T-002.Title: Review every proposal and selectively adopt suitable wording

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The controller reads each report and difference, records its disposition, preserves professional and defined terms, rejects semantic changes, and applies only accepted wording at its original source owner.

Verification.Evidence: Per-document review inventory and accepted/rejected differences; substantive issues recorded separately.

T-003.Title: Reconcile the affected Russian page content and comparison metadata

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Paired page meanings remain equivalent, unchanged Russian wording is retained when appropriate, and source comparison hashes are refreshed only after review.

Verification.Evidence: Paired review notes and changed-source list.

T-004.Title: Regenerate and verify the complete portal

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Both language routes build with working links, navigation, diagrams and search; repeat output is identical, and changed pages preserve readable desktop and mobile layout.

Verification.Evidence: Changed-route browser inspection and source-preservation evidence.
